style: Create a single production game UI art asset for Blinopek. Reference image 1 is the authoritative painterly style, NOT the required subject. Match the cozy domestic gouache/dry-oil painting: warm cream, faded mint, dusty rose, chestnut and charcoal. Deliberately non-uniform brushwork: a few broad calm opaque planes, thin scumbled passages only at selected edges, occasional small precise strokes; stroke width, pressure and direction vary with material. Mix lost and found edges and a little asymmetry. No all-over coarse noise, repeating canvas filter, evenly distributed scratches, photorealism, shiny 3D, vector-cartoon game assets, neon glow or ornate fantasy decoration. This is an independent asset with full uncut silhouette, generous clean margin, genuinely transparent background (no painted checkerboard), no cast shadow detached from the object. NO letters, words, numbers, labels, watermarks, annotation or mockup device.

specs.title: Кремовая панель
specs.spec: One blank cream-painted wooden/enamel rectangular interface panel, landscape 3:2, gently rounded subtly imperfect corners, thin hand-painted dark brown edge. Wide quiet light center for later runtime text, no central scratches, faint rose/teal paint only near perimeter. Absolutely no decorations or symbols.

specs.title: Кнопка кремовая
specs.spec: One blank compact horizontal rounded rectangular cream enamel game button, width:height about 2.4:1, dark brown hand-painted rim with slight irregularity, quiet clean center. Strong tappable silhouette, modest lower lip, no icon, no decorative corner flourishes.

specs.title: Вкладка шалфейная
specs.spec: One blank small sage-teal cloth/paper tab with rounded upper corners and straight lower edge, 1.7:1. Quiet matte painted center, irregular dark teal thin outline, restrained cream tiny edge accent. No lettering, no stitching pattern repeated everywhere.

specs.title: Рамка карточки
specs.spec: One empty portrait cream painted card with subtle warm wooden edge, aspect 3:4. Generous quiet light central display area and blank lower price strip demarcated by one fine brown stroke, gently irregular corners. No numbers, no image in center, no label, no ornaments.

specs.title: Облако реплики
coverage: Стойка и диалог: облако и варианты
specs.spec: One large landscape hand-painted cream speech bubble 3:1, small downward pointing tail near lower-left quarter, thin uneven brown contour, warm paper body mostly smooth. Empty interior with huge clear writing area, no text or dots.

specs.title: Шкала терпения
specs.spec: One narrow horizontal empty progress track in a cream enamel frame, about 6:1, rounded ends, deep muted brown inner well. No fill, no icons or text. Spare restrained painterly edge texture and calm broad surfaces.

specs.title: Монета с блином
specs.spec: One iconic round warm brass coin bearing a simple embossed thin pancake with three irregular little pores, slightly oblique frontal view, painterly ochre planes, 2 restrained cream edge highlights. NO stack, no dollar sign, no sparkle.

specs.title: Янтарная капля мёда
specs.spec: One amber honey drop currency icon, organic plump tear shape, matte layered ochre and rusty-orange translucent color impression, a single restrained soft cream highlight, irregular deep brown edge. No faceted gemstone, no glow.

specs.title: Книга рецептов: обложка
specs.spec: One old closed domestic recipe notebook, plain faded sage cloth cover with blank cream paper patch, modest worn corners, cream page block, burgundy narrow cloth bookmark. Front three-quarter view, no words, no logo or fancy embossed fantasy insignia.

specs.title: Книга рецептов: разворот
specs.spec: One open recipe notebook in a nearly frontal slight top-down view, broad two blank cream pages, lightly uneven paper edges and a soft central crease, small muted teal cover edge, 3:2 landscape. No handwriting, lines, illustrations or printed rules; calm wide writable surfaces.

specs.title: Записка заказа
specs.spec: One small cream order slip icon clipped by a plain dark metal paperclip at top, three short uneven brown horizontal strokes as abstract pictogram, no readable letters or numbers, slightly bent bottom corner, no dramatic shadow.

specs.title: Значок помощника начинки
specs.spec: One small circular off-white enamel badge containing a simple dark hand-painted little spoon beside a 6-tooth muted ochre gear. Two clear silhouettes within one badge. No futuristic robot face, no lettering. Graphic easy to read at 40px, textured sparingly only around rim.

specs.title: Игровые часы
specs.spec: One small homely round cream kitchen clock icon, charcoal rim, two dark hands and four short tick marks, no numbers. Clock reads roughly 2:30. Broad calm cream face, tiny warm worn edge, muted teal shadow at lower edge.

specs.title: Значок рабочего дня
specs.spec: One modest warm ochre sun pictogram, slightly irregular circular disc with six short uneven rays, warm cream highlight, dark brown painted contour. No face, glow, sparkles, gradient halo or sunset scene.

specs.title: Оценка гостя
specs.spec: One simple slightly asymmetrical five-point ochre star badge painted on a small cream circular backing. Matte color, sparse visible brush edge, readable tiny. No shiny metal, glitter or ornate framing.

specs.title: Чаевые
specs.spec: A compact icon of two overlapping humble warm brass pancake coins beside a tiny painted upward curved mark. Clear two-coin silhouette, restrained broad matte planes, cream accent, no symbols or words, no treasure pile.

specs.title: Возврат оплаты
specs.spec: One compact icon: a single humble brass pancake coin with a clear muted brick-red curved return arrow wrapping around its lower-left side. Spare painterly strokes, no letters, no excessive texture or shine.

specs.title: Больше гостей
specs.spec: One small cream square painted badge with three simple shoulder-and-head silhouettes grouped together in muted teal, ochre and dusty rose, varied sizes. No faces or text, flat emblem painted by hand, warm quiet background.

specs.title: Больше терпения
specs.spec: One small cream square painted badge with a relaxed simple human face in muted ochre and a modest tiny teal clock next to it. Sincere restrained smile, two small dark eye dashes, no emoji-gloss or glossy cheeks. No text.

specs.title: Ускорение плиты
specs.spec: One small cream square painted badge showing a simplified old cream enamel stove burner and a little ochre clock hand pair beside it. Readable simple contours, muted teal and dark brown, sparse material brushwork. No lightning bolt fantasy glow or text.

specs.title: Трафареты
specs.spec: One small cream square painted badge showing a dark teal circular crepe outline and four dotted placement rings within it. Hand-painted yet clear, restrained brown rim, no food portions, no text.

specs.title: Ремонт плиты
specs.spec: One small cream square painted badge showing an old enamel stove front with one modest muted brick-red crack mark and a short dark iron wrench diagonally alongside. Readable at small size, no explosion, rust disaster or text. This is a repair icon, not a scene damage overlay.

specs.title: Просмотр за награду
specs.spec: One compact cream rounded rectangular card icon with a dark teal triangular play sign and a single small ochre pancake coin overlapping lower right corner. Hand-painted plain enamel and brass, quiet simple planes. No filmstrip clutter, text or shiny bevel.

specs.title: Билет без просмотра
specs.spec: One small faded golden-ochre paper ticket with modest semicircular notches at ends, centered dark teal play triangle crossed by one subtle cream diagonal stroke to denote skip, sparse brown outline. No words, numbers, serial, ornate border or glitter.

specs.title: Настройка звука
specs.spec: One small hand-painted dark teal speaker pictogram with two curved sound-wave strokes on a tiny cream enamel disc. Calm simple matte color, mildly uneven contours, no text or glows.

specs.title: Счётчик готовых порций
specs.spec: One small cream plate icon with blue-green painted rim and a single golden folded thin crepe on it, 3/4 slightly overhead view. Simple readable graphic, spare painterly marks, no topping, no text. It is a small UI symbol, not a large dish render.
